answer.summary: Rahul Vohra’s Switch log records what he actually works on, rather than what his calendar planned: each time he changes tasks, he sends a brief “TS:” note to Slack, then reviews the log at week’s end to see where his time went.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.content: Vohra says a calendar shows what you thought you would do, while your trail of work shows what you actually did. Whenever he switches tasks, he sends his EA—or a Slackbot—a Slack DM beginning “TS:” followed by a few words describing the task. This lets him follow what feels right to work on and record changes as they happen; at the end of the week, he reviews the log and can graph or chart how his time was spent. He cautions that this is not a reason to skip meetings or one-on-ones.
